name: Kanrinin - Reitetsu Reijou wa Gakuen Ryou ni Shizumu
original_name: 姦裏人 冷徹令嬢は学園寮に沈む
source:
There is a man called the "Manager." Making a living by doing businesses in the underworld, he is also known by his true identity "Dark Shipper." At the request of his clients, he provides a "thorough management" to their targets, after making them into an "obedient product", they are shipped to his clients.

One such job takes him to the prestigious school "Shuchi'in Acedemy", a gathering place for the people who are expected to play major roles in the future in various fields such as economy, politics, and entertainment. A request arrives for the "production" of a girl who attends this school, the daughter of the Himemo Group, Himeno Satsuki.

Accepting the request, the "Manager" prepares himself, getting ready to infiltrate the school.

[Translated and edited from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1245381]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
有个男人，人称“管理员”。他靠地下生意谋生，真正的行当是“地下发货人”。依委托人的要求，他会对目标实行“彻底管理”，把人变成“听话的商品”之后，再送到客户手里。

这次，业务让他盯上了一所名校“秀知院学园”。从经济、政治到演艺，各界有望在未来担负重任的人才都汇聚于此。他收到一份委托，要他将这里的一名学生、姬乃集团的千金姬乃皋月，“加工成品”。

“管理员”接下委托，做好了潜入学园的准备。

［编译自[url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1245381]Getchu[/url]］
